title: The Effect of Plantar Vibration on the Progression of Peripheral Neuropathy
brief_summary: The purpose of this study is to assess the effect of vibration of the plantar surface of the foot on peripheral neuropathy.
raw_criteria:
Inclusion Criteria:

* Clinical evidence of neuropathy
* Normal to moderate evidence of neuropathy on nerve conduction studies

Exclusion Criteria:

* Currently on medications with a known risk of neuropathy
* Pregnant
* Evidence of peripheral vascular disease
